comment: composable_tv [ds] arm: disjoint-support FULL-FT task vectors, merge-only serving (no per-task mask, no task id). Each pool author may only update a seeded, data-independent, pairwise-disjoint index set S_a (support_seed partitions each tensor's SHA-256-seeded permutation; density = |S_a|/numel), so merged weights restricted to S_a are EXACTLY tau_a and deletion = bitwise subtract of the stored sparse tau. Full-FT: train.rank/alpha/rslora are canonical-schema placeholders, unused here (hence no r32 in out_dir). Budget: full-batch training makes one Adam step == one epoch, so epochs=25 -> 25 steps at train.lr (sift precedent). Pool authors derive at runtime from merge_subset.subset_authors(pool_seed, pool_size).
